summary.text: On Dominaria, time rifts widen across the plane, draining mana and warping the multiverse.
Teferi and Jhoira return to find the plane nearly devoid of mana, while Jeska, newly ignited as a planeswalker, appears searching for Karn.
Legendary planeswalkers sacrifice their sparks or lives to close the rifts, and Jeska's final sacrifice closes the last one, catalyzing the Great Mending in which planeswalkers become mortal mages.
